scope: read-only, lexical/source-aware candidate experiment; no runtime integration, model, download or network API
query: finite whole RU/EN information-request frames with a literal topic; no owner/pronoun/quoted/compound intent inference
occurrence: finite impersonal past-action grammar in identical whole fact.text/source quote, with selected-source proof; no reported/negated/question/conditional assertion promotion
typed: current accepted kind plus terminal task status or persistent claim, with genuine frozen available source role and selected lineage; neither authorship nor kind event alone is completion proof
mandatory: all prior compiled tasks/claims/nonempty frozen roles retained; an unproved baseline, unknown topic/source/identity, or union overflow returns exact baseline
order: eligible literal/source-backed priorities, then mandatory baseline sources, then unchanged lexical order
admission: whole actual compiler prompt only; cap8 and full cost; preserve budget-specific mandatory sources, otherwise exact original prompt
metrics: complete sets, wrong first, lost lexical gold, mandatory loss, control drift and actual full-prompt admission separately
evaluation: new 64 development and 32 holdout cases fixed before algorithm; do not tune after results; past RP263/264 cases are not holdout
